components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main next step on a page.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.9rem; align-items:center; padding:.65rem 1rem; border-radius:10px; background:#17151d; color:#fff; font:700 1rem/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #b69cff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Information note
components.description: Short operational context that belongs beside a decision.
components.html: A WireGuard profile contains private key material.
components.css: .ds-note { max-width:70ch; padding:1.2rem 1.3rem; border-radius:14px; background:#eee9fb; color:#38266e; font:400 1rem/1.65 'Atkinson Hyperlegible',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Documentation first: decisive headings, calm reading columns, visible limits and restrained use of the FAV violet.

rules.name: Rationed Accent
rules.body: Use violet for orientation and actions, not large decoration.

dos: Place security limits beside the decisions they affect.
Use spacing and rules before another container.
donts: Do not fabricate proof or guarantees.
Do not decorate with terminals, grids or glowing gradients.
